protocol.name: BPF Loader (classic)
protocol.note: Tier-0 foundational native program (added 2026-08-08): deploys and finalizes non-upgradeable BPF programs (owns the classic memo MemoSq4gq and legacy memo Memo1Uhk accounts). Discriminators from the Solana/Agave bpf_loader source. Deploy instructions are rare in everyday traffic but security-relevant (program deployment).

instructions.name: Write
expected_state_changes: writes a chunk of program ELF bytes into the program account during deployment
risk_rules: program deployment primitive — deployer must be trusted

instructions.name: Finalize
expected_state_changes: finalizes a deployed program, making it executable
risk_rules: program deployment primitive — deployer must be trusted
